subject: Re: Kickoff: ArtVLM attribute recognition for catalog enrichment
body:
Dmitri,

Allocations confirmed. Csilla 60%, Kaia 50%, Saoirse 40% through July. Vera Egede is locked in at 70% on ArtVLM for all of June 2026 - she owns the prefix-LM scoring path and the VGARank eval harness, and I have no backfill for her. If anyone comes asking for her time in June the answer is no.

Compute is modest: fine-tuning fits on titan-a100 best-effort, 32-64 GPUs per run. No Vulcan reservation needed this half.

Dependencies: catalog ingestion goes through Corpus, and I want us fully migrated before the v2 freeze on 7/10 so we're not scrambling. Saoirse is already talking to Jun's team.

One ask: budget for ~200 hours of human verification on auto-generated attribute labels. Can you find that in the portfolio budget?

Daniela
